detail.longDescription: I'm working on a responsive web app. On iPhones, Safari and chrome, automatically zooms in whenever a user focuses on an input or other form controls. I came across a few similar questions here, but couldn't find a suitable answer for my requirement. I don't want to change the existing font size to min 16px . Also, want users to be able to manually pinch-to-zoom on both iOS and Android. Is there any way to prevent automatic zoom on input focus without disabling manual pinch-to-zoom or increasing font size? I tried maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no . both breaks in pinch zoom. Making 16px font size is not possible for me as it is a large complex web application with congested things.
